open_points.subject: owner_interface → models dependency for OperationAnswer variants
open_points.text:
`_render_owner_page` takes the whole union
and renders every variant as itself
open_points.question: Does `_render_owner_page` directly name or type-check every listed concrete answer variant at runtime, or does it name only `OperationAnswer` and render through a discriminant or common interface?
options: Directly match every listed variant and import them all
Import only `OperationAnswer`; concrete variants enter model context transitively
Directly reference only a stated subset of variants and import that subset
open_points.default_guess: Directly pattern-match every listed variant, because the dependency list explicitly includes all of them.

open_points.subject: owner_interface models dependency declaration
open_points.text:
`OperationAnswer`
and each of its variants, since `_render_owner_page` takes the whole union
and renders every variant as itself: `ValidationAnswer`, `ContextAnswer`,
`ProjectCardAnswer`, `ProjectListAnswer`, `ProjectErasedAnswer`,
`RoomsAnswer`, `RoomAnswer`, `PointersAnswer`, `LatestPointerAnswer`,
`PointerAnswer`, `BillingAnswer`, `CustomerAnswer`, `CustomerListAnswer`,
`SessionAccessAnswer`, `SessionListAnswer`, `SessionEndedAnswer`,
`RequestPendingAnswer`, `AgentProjectionAnswer`, `AuditViewAnswer`,
`AuditErasedAnswer`, `ImportUploadAnswer`, `ImportMappingAnswer`,
`ImportAcceptedAnswer`, `ConfirmationStepAnswer`, `SignedInAnswer`,
`SignedOutAnswer`, `NewestBackupAnswer` and `RefusedAnswer`;
open_points.rule: Для provider-а `models` перечисляй ровно модели, enum и interface, которые consumer непосредственно называет, конструирует или проверяет в своём runtime коде. Тип поля выбранной модели, variants discriminated union и другие транзитивные model-ссылки расширяют model-context локального прохода и входят в Python-import consumer-а только тогда, когда consumer обращается к ним сам: сравнивает с членом enum (`Cardinality.MANY`), конструирует вложенную модель, проверяет тип
open_points.question: Replace the union-membership rationale with an explicit statement that runtime code directly checks or names every listed variant, or remove from the dependency surface every concrete variant that is reached only transitively through `OperationAnswer`.
